title: Software Developer 3
description:
Software Developer 3 / Full Stack Developer
 
We are seeking a senior Full Stack Software Developer to support enterprise application development, reporting solutions, cloud-based integrations, and legacy system modernization for a Texas public-sector client.
 
This role will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, testing, deploying, and supporting secure, scalable applications using .NET Core, C#, React JS, SQL Server, Oracle, Power BI, and Azure. The developer will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, analysts, and IT teams in an Agile environment.
 
Responsibilities include:
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using .NET Core, C#, React JS, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Build and support backend services, APIs, and frontend web applications.
Develop and optimize SQL Server databases, stored procedures, views, functions, and queries.
Perform Oracle data migration and support legacy system modernization.
Develop Power BI dashboards, reports, paginated reports, and data transformations.
Support cloud-based application development, deployment, monitoring, and security using Azure or similar cloud platforms.
Troubleshoot production issues across the full technology stack.
Use CI/CD pipelines, Git, and DevOps tools for automated builds, testing, and deployments.
Collaborate with business and technical teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
 
Required Skills:
11+ years of full stack development experience using .NET Core, C#, React JS, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
11+ years of SQL Server experience, including data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning.
11+ years of Oracle experience, including Oracle data migration.
11+ years of Power BI experience, including dashboards, paginated reports, and data transformations.
11+ years of hands-on cloud platform experience, Azure preferred.
11+ years of CI/CD, Git, and DevOps tools experience.
11+ years of experience converting legacy applications to web-based solutions.
Knowledge of accessibility standards, including Section 508.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
 
Preferred Skills:
Experience supporting government, healthcare, public sector, or regulated environments.
Experience working with Texas state agencies.
Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release activities.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field preferred.
Possible extension to FY27.

title: Recruiter Sr
description:
Technical Recruiter 
 
The Technical Recruiter will manage the full recruitment lifecycle for technical roles, including sourcing, screening, qualifying, submitting, and supporting candidates through the interview and offer process. This role partners closely with hiring managers and stakeholders to understand technical hiring needs, build strong candidate pipelines, and deliver a high-quality candidate experience.
 
Key Responsibilities
Manage full-cycle recruiting for technical positions, including software engineering, architecture, cloud, data, cybersecurity, DevOps, and IT infrastructure roles.
Source, screen, interview, and qualify candidates using job boards, internet searches, databases, referrals, networking, and sourcing tools.
Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements, review candidates, advise on talent availability, and support hiring decisions.
Post job advertisements and maintain accurate candidate activity and requisition updates in the ATS.
Build and maintain diverse talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Use recruiting analytics, market intelligence, compensation insights, funnel metrics, and pipeline data to guide recruiting strategy.
Support salary discussions, offer coordination, and candidate closing efforts.
Manage multiple recruiting priorities while maintaining strong communication with candidates, hiring managers, and stakeholders.
 
Required Skills and Experience
5+ years of technical recruiting experience.
Experience recruiting for technical roles such as software engineers, architects, cloud engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity analysts, DevOps engineers, or IT infrastructure professionals.
Strong understanding of SDLC, cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and modern technology stacks.
Experience managing full-cycle recruiting while maintaining a high-touch candidate experience.
Ability to influence and advise hiring managers using market trends, compensation insights, and real-time talent availability.
Strong sourcing skills and ability to identify, engage, and qualify technical talent.
Experience using recruiting analytics, including time-to-fill, funnel metrics, pipeline health, and market intelligence.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong time management skills with the ability to manage multiple roles and priorities simultaneously.
 
Technology Tools
Workday or similar Applicant Tracking System
Eightfold or similar CRM tool
LinkedIn, HireEZ, or similar sourcing tools
